svg.title: Vaughn Valle: hardware security researcher
svg.desc: A terminal running fastfetch. On the left, a grid of real SRAM power-up bits from an ESP32 spells whoami, with metastable cells flickering as 10 recorded cold boots replay. On the right: Vaughn Valle, computer engineering student and hardware security researcher at NYU Tandon, class of 2027, working on SRAM PUFs, quantum entropy, and LLM-assisted RTL verification; applying to PhD programs for Fall 2027.

g.text: SRAM PUFs · quantum entropy · LLM RTL verification
Applying to PhD programs for Fall 2027
Not my commit graph lol ↑ real ESP32 SRAM bits · 10 cold boots
